_comment: The approved job queue for the idle-GPU scheduler. THE bounded gate: a job runs only when approved===true AND status==='queued' AND a capable idle node exists AND every brake is go. The examples below are INERT illustrations (the queue ships effectively empty: one is unapproved, one is already done). Real jobs are added by Darrell, with approved:true set deliberately.

items.note: EXAMPLE — unapproved, so it never runs. A real harvest-transcription job would set approved:true once Darrell reviews it.
EXAMPLE — already done, so it never re-runs (idempotent). Shows the status guard.
